timer.durable_end: return from fsync on a pre-opened /workspace directory descriptor
timer.quota_alignment: wait for the next CFS period before all before-boundary reads; alignment is outside the timer

resource_measurement.poller: separate read-only PID-sharing sidecar cgroup with SYS_PTRACE; no target CPU or memory charge
resource_measurement.target_boundaries: target cgroup and daemon schedstat read immediately before command start and after fsyncdir return

per_measured_sample.daemon_cpu: sum task schedstat delta <= floor(1.05*T_to_durable)+5000000 ns
per_measured_sample.largest_request: <=1048576 bytes; this is not a product-wide allocation claim
per_measured_sample.timed_terminal: PASS, joined session, root-only cache ownership, dirty/pending/spool/Q/handles zero

resource_measurement.focused_probe_policy: stat, mkdir, copy, and overwrite each enforce the population ratios individually before the full campaign

acceptance.numeric_latency_gate_reason: No deployed restart-durable Cloudflare population exists. Live/transient thresholds are not reused.

scenario_generation_delta.git init + commit 100 files: at least 1; Git may acknowledge internal fsyncs during T_live

zero_final_state_policy.rm_row: final-state durability only; explicit no-op/final barrier is still timed
zero_final_state_policy.separate_history_oracle: create -> barrier -> delete -> barrier -> SIGKILL -> verified reopen

cloudflare_policy.full_product_comparison_requires: deployed post-exec Durable Object pull plus restart proof
